description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirement the target takes the duel (attacks you or accepts the challenge)

Effect both of you make a single Strike against the other simultaneously; whichever hit deals more damage is treated as a critical hit, the other as a complete miss

A formally offered duel resolves in one exchange.

cinderfall.incomplete: Both combatants make a single Strike against each other simultaneously; whichever deals more damage is treated as a critical hit, the other as a complete miss. No rule element compares two separately-rolled Strikes' outcomes to reclassify one as a guaranteed crit and the other as a guaranteed miss -- this is a different shape of "manufactured" result than AdjustDegreeOfSuccess can reach (which only reclassifies a single roll's own degree, never compares it against a second roll), and no analog exists anywhere in the engine.
